title: Monthly revenue by line of business
description: Revenue (NII + fees) across the whole book for each of the last 24 closed months, one line per line of business.

custom.cypher:
MATCH (r:RevenueMonth)
RETURN r.month AS month,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.lob = 'Corporate Banking' THEN r.totalUsd ELSE 0 END) AS corporateBankingUsd,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.lob = 'Commercial Lending' THEN r.totalUsd ELSE 0 END) AS commercialLendingUsd,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.lob = 'Capital Markets' THEN r.totalUsd ELSE 0 END) AS capitalMarketsUsd,
       sum(CASE WHEN r.lob = 'Global Markets' THEN r.totalUsd ELSE 0 END) AS globalMarketsUsd
ORDER BY month
